text: Citizen [ME. citezein , from Lat. civitas , a state]: Ger. Bürger ; Fr. citoyen ; Ital. borghese , cittadino . Originally any person enjoying municipal rights in a city; subsequently used to signify (1) a mere inhabitant of a city, or (2) a person enjoying political rights in a sovereign STATE (q.v.) ( F.C.M. )
